title: Iron Haze component diagram
description: Iron Haze: a Godot 4 project exported for the browser and the desktop, and a Worker that serves both, behind icelander.net's sign-in and the role games:iron-haze, to invited players only.

components.name: Iron Haze
components.responsibility: One game: the Godot project, the page files and the Worker, built by build.mjs and deployed together with wrangler.

components.name: Godot project
components.responsibility: The game: world builder, procedural models and effects, units, structures, the player's controls, the HUD and the enemy AI (godot/scripts/), with a headless self-test (godot/tests/selftest.gd).

components.name: Page files
components.responsibility: The landing page (play in the browser, or download), the play page's stylesheet and boot script (the CSP allows no inline script), the icon and the headers.

components.name: Iron Haze Worker
components.responsibility: Serves every file to signed-in holders of games:iron-haze, sends visitors to sign in, shows others a not-invited page, and joins the parted engine and downloads.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who holds the site_session cookie, and their games: roles.

relationships.description: Exported by Godot (build.mjs) to dist/games/fresh/iron-haze/play/ and to three desktop zips.
Copied into dist/ by build.mjs, the landing page filled in with the downloads' sizes.
Service binding ACCOUNTS, through vendor/icelander-auth: requireRole(games:iron-haze) on every request but the stylesheet and the icon.
